style.promptPrefix: A clean, friendly square illustration for a children's language-learning flashcard. Simple flat soft style, soft rounded shapes, gentle shading, even lighting. Plain light beige or cream background, no scene, no floor grid, no border. No text, no letters, no typography, no numbers written as glyphs, no watermark, no logo, no caption. Centered single subject, generous margin, consistent character proportions if people are shown, warm gentle colors, not cute-grotesque, not 3D render, not photoreal, not anime-detailed.
style.notes: One image per concept id. Filename vocab/img/<concept_id>.jpg, square 256px, JPEG quality ~82, no text in the image. Reuse this promptPrefix and only change the subject clause.
